summary: The {{destination}} refused {{failures}} deliveries between {{first_time}} and {{last_time}}. The most common reply was "{{top_error}}". Affected orders include {{affected}}.
likely_cause: The {{destination}} was overloaded or briefly down. Errors in the 500 range come from its side, not from the data we sent, and they started and stopped in a short burst.
suggested_fix: No action needed for these orders: each one is retried automatically, up to {{max_attempts}} times with a growing pause. If this keeps happening, check the {{destination}} status page or hosting plan limits. Deliveries waiting in the dead letter queue right now: {{dead_count}}.
